rows.label: Standard deduction: Single
rows.note: Maximum; reduced by 12% of Wisconsin income over $20,119 and $0 at $136,453.

rows.label: Standard deduction: Head of household
rows.note: Maximum; reduced by 22.515% of income over $20,119, then follows the single schedule; $0 at $136,453.

rows.label: Standard deduction: Married filing jointly
rows.note: Maximum; reduced by 19.778% of income over $29,039 and $0 at $159,690.

rows.label: Standard deduction: Married filing separately
rows.note: Maximum; reduced by 19.778% of income over $13,779 and $0 at $75,869.
